preregistration.design: 36 Reference-only cases; substeps {1,2,4,8,16}; invariant integrated balance scale 1.6e-15 cm
preregistration.note: D1 was preregistered and first executed before P2E18 provenance was finalized to the six-level {1,2,4,8,16,32} design. D1 is therefore retained as a five-level mechanistic diagnostic, not rewritten post hoc.

reference_baseline_for_comparison.note: The physical case set and first five refinement levels match. P2E18 used fixed balance-rate tolerances; D1 changes only CritDevBalCp/Tot according to 1.6e-15/dt.

exact_reproduction.head: 2a1c3376d23e4074f50020649c6c0769460e447a
exact_reproduction.note: Workflow-only trigger comment; scientific authorities unchanged.

interpretation.supported: Fixed rate tolerances are a major contributor to the P2E18 refinement-route collapse: the invariant-integrated policy restores all 36 cases at 8 substeps and 35 of 36 at 16 substeps.
interpretation.rejected: The fixed-rate scaling alone is not sufficient to make the required fine Reference route universally valid, because B01/Se=0.65/DRYING still retries at substep 16 under the scaled policy.
interpretation.caution: D1 did not include 32 substeps and does not qualify REF-HIGH stability. The 16-substep failure already falsifies sufficiency under its preregistered criterion, so 32 is not retroactively appended to D1.

next_permitted_action: Run a separate Reference-only causal diagnostic on the remaining scaled-policy retry events, exposing whether the final nonconvergence is balance-gate, head-change-gate, or both. Do not loosen tolerances and do not begin RossFast timing.
